Frontend (/orders, 1920×1080, admin@nexus.com): order-row-11571862893 renders with TRENDYOL channel badge, customer 'Mustafa Bal', İstanbul, 1× 'Duvar Rafı Çizgili C8 35x20cm DRC-35, 35 x 19' at 459,00 ₺, tracking 7330036871799757; order-select checkbox → orders-bulk-bar visible with bulk-thermal-btn, bulk-labels-btn, bulk-delete-btn all visible; bulk-thermal-btn opens new window titled 'Kargo Etiketleri (1)' with 1 .label element + CODE128 <svg> and @page 100mm 150mm in content; tab-claims → claims-panel, tab-cancelled → cancelled-panel, tab-questions → questions-panel all render without console errors. order-delete-11571862893 button present (real order not invoiced) — NOT clicked per instructions. /ecommerce Trendyol card 'Test Et' click updated Son Senkronizasyon timestamp (11:42→11:45) confirming live API call; 'Sipariş Çek' triggered live sync. No console errors. All TEST_it24 orders cleaned up (verified 0 remaining).

issues: Toast messages disappear too quickly (sonner default ~2s?) — success/live sync verification relies on 'Son Senkronizasyon' timestamp change. Consider longer toast duration for live sync results with metrics.

critical_code_review_comments: TrendyolClient.orders() correctly chunks date range into 14-day windows (Trendyol API limit) and de-duplicates by package id — good.
_upsert_marketplace_orders preserves invoice_id/is_invoiced/contact_id/internal_note/label_printed_at on re-sync — prevents accidental overwrite of local invoicing state. Good.

sync_ecommerce_channel: when calling client.claims()/questions() live, order sync of pkgs still happens even if claims/questions call throws — actually they are all awaited before any DB write; if questions call throws after orders fetched, orders won't be persisted. Consider try/except around claims/questions separately so partial results are saved.

test_ecommerce_connection issues client.orders(days=1) on every ping which consumes rate limit budget. Trendyol allows only 50 req/10s across all endpoints, so back-to-back UI Test Et + Sipariş Çek can hit 429. Consider a lighter probe (e.g., /suppliers/{id}/products?size=1) for connection test.

answer_marketplace_question returns 400 on 'WAITING_FOR_ANSWER' status mismatch AFTER 400 short-text check — but short-text uses len<10 which counts characters not bytes; Turkish chars are fine. Acceptable.

bulk_delete_orders calls delete_order() which raises HTTPException for invoiced orders and continue-swallows — this silently skips invoiced orders with no per-id failure reason returned to UI. Consider returning {deleted, skipped:[{id, reason}]} for better UX.
mark_labels_printed accepts any ids (no company_id scoping / no auth check) — potential cross-tenant risk if multi-tenant expands.
OrdersB2BPage.jsx line 348 — inline confirm+delete for individual orders is fine but toast on failure exposes raw backend detail; acceptable for admin CRM.
Frontend delete button uses window.confirm — brittle in automated tests but acceptable.

rca_of_the_issue: Original user report ('Trendyol siparişi düşmedi') RCA: prior implementation was fully simulated (marketplace_providers.simulated_orders returned static Ayşe Gökmen record with is_simulated=true and never called Trendyol). E1 fix: added real httpx-based TrendyolClient with proper HTTP Basic auth (api_key/api_secret), storefrontCode header, seller-namespaced paths, 14-day chunked orders/claims fetching, and questions filter endpoint. server.py test_ecommerce_connection now issues client.orders(days=1,size=1) live probe → returns 401/403/429 as HTTPException with Turkish detail. sync_ecommerce_channel maps packages via map_trendyol_order + upserts by (company_id, channel, order_number) preserving local invoice state. Live sync of the real seller (supplier 304401) successfully imports order 11571862893 with all Trendyol fields. Auto-sync loop wakes every 10 min. Frontend: bulk thermal 100×150 mm labels use CODE128 svg with @page CSS, tab panels for Claims/Cancelled/Questions render marketplace collections.
